LanguageData.RHA_GuardianTrial030_root.label: First watch
LanguageData.RHA_GuardianTrial030_root.description: Threat: A marked threat pursues the protected target for this phase. Answer: The applicant damages that threat, effectively heals the protected target, or absorbs its hits with a shield. Reward: The three effective contributions share the phase threshold; the threat takes 25% more damage for 8 seconds. Cost: Ignoring the threat pressures the protected target; a solo applicant protects themself. Arrangement: Ordered strikes; Locked impact. New first clears teach counters; refinements deepen coordination. Roles change no faster than every 30 seconds. Locked attacks never track; ordinary attacks and early kills work. Existing finite roster retained.
